expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: in 2024 retries that drew a fresh idempotency key charged
members twice, which is why every attempt sends the same key.
expectations.evidence: The message mentions only a generic risk ('retrying after a timeout can charge the card again if the previous attempt succeeded') and does not raise the 2024 incident where retries with fresh idempotency keys charged members twice (41 members), nor explain that the same key is sent on every attempt on purpose; it also made the change without asking first.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/payments.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/payments.md at step 8; first edit at step 12
